answer_text: No. Cato Sockets do not support jumbo frames on Socket LAN ports. For a LAN-port frame larger than 1500 bytes, the Socket checks the Do Not Fragment (DF) bit: if DF is not set, the packet is accepted and fragmented to the 1500-byte limit; if DF is set, the packet is dropped and an ICMP Fragmentation Needed message is sent back to the sender.
